environment.description: Quarkus native serverless handler deployed on AWS Lambda behind API Gateway HTTP API (no additional request filtering). CloudFront distribution configured with default cache behavior forwarding all headers including X-Forwarded-Host and X-Cache-Variant to origin. Origin access is unrestricted (public ALB endpoint). No origin access control or signed URL requirement. Cache behavior uses query string and header-based cache keys matching the application's Vary headers.

config.api_gateway: HTTP API with $default route, no request validation
